en: The image depicts a snowy winter scene in a town, with several houses partially covered in snow, bare trees, and people walking or standing in the foreground. There is a kiosk or bulletin pillar with advertisements, a bridge in the middle distance, and a hilly, forested background. The postcard is monochrome (black and white), with text at the bottom left and right corners.
